p.0: Technical articles, case studies, and industry reports from Gausin's process engineering team — covering dairy, pharma, chemical, food, and environmental sectors.
p.1: Thermo Vapour Recompression (TVR) is a proven energy-saving upgrade for dairy, sugar, and food processing evaporators. Using a steam jet thermocompressor, TVR entrains low-pressure secondary vapour with high-pressure motive steam and recompresses it back into the heating circuit — cutting live steam consumption by up to 50% without the capital cost of a full mechanical compressor system. This article explains thermocompressor sizing, motive steam requirements, integration with falling film and multi-effect plants, and when TVR is the right choice over conventional multi-effect or MVR systems.
p.2: Gausin designed and commissioned a complete 1 Lakh Litre Per Day milk processing plant including reception dock, chilling, pasteurisation, homogenisation, filling, and CIP — delivered in 14 months from PO to commissioning.
p.3: A 100 KLD distillery faced CPCB zero liquid discharge mandate. Gausin integrated a biogas plant, multiple-effect evaporator, incinerator, and scrubber to achieve full ZLD compliance — converting waste into 800 m³/day of biogas.
p.4: A leading pharmaceutical manufacturer required a fully automated, validated CIP/SIP system for their injectable drug facility. Gausin delivered a 3-vessel CIP skid with PLC control, data logging, and FDA-ready validation documentation.
p.5: Both evaporator types have distinct advantages depending on product viscosity, fouling tendency, heat sensitivity, and throughput. This guide compares design, energy use, maintenance, and ideal applications across dairy, chemical, and pharma sectors.
p.6: Optimising inlet air temperature, feed concentration, atomisation type (rotary vs. nozzle), and chamber geometry is critical for particle size distribution, bulk density, and solubility. This article walks through key design decisions for dairy spray drying.
p.7: Choosing between shell & tube and plate-type heat exchangers involves evaluating pressure, temperature range, fluid viscosity, fouling factors, and space constraints. This guide provides selection criteria with real-world application examples from food and chemical plants.
p.8: India's dairy sector processes over 230 million tonnes of milk annually. Yet over 60% of cooperatives still rely on outdated batch processing. This report maps the technology adoption gap and identifies key equipment upgrade opportunities in evaporation, drying, and CIP.
p.9: CPCB's tightening discharge norms and the push for Zero Liquid Discharge are reshaping wastewater engineering in pharmaceutical, chemical, and food sectors. This report covers the regulatory landscape, technology options, and ZLD system design frameworks.
p.10: WHO-GMP and Schedule M revisions are forcing hundreds of Indian pharmaceutical manufacturers to upgrade process equipment and utilities. This report outlines the equipment categories under highest demand, compliance timelines, and engineering considerations.
p.11: Before requesting a quotation for an evaporator, gathering the right process data saves time and ensures accurate equipment sizing. This checklist covers feed concentration, product sensitivity, steam availability, capacity, and utility conditions.
p.12: Effective CIP design ensures consistent microbial reduction, chemical efficiency, and compliance with FSSAI and HACCP standards. This guide covers flow velocity targets, detergent selection, temperature programming, and automated sequence design.
p.13: Indian IBR regulations and ASME Section VIII govern pressure vessel design in India, but many buyers are unsure which applies to their application. This guide explains code selection, design pressure calculation, documentation requirements, and IBR inspection milestones.
p.14: Our engineering team is available to discuss your process requirements, review your specifications, and propose the right solution. Reach out for a free technical consultation.
